[[Librarian Gahmir Lenon]] can be found in the center of the deepest corridor of the [[Halls of Chokhin]] near [[Lyssa]]'s shrine.

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Holdings of Chokhin}} (inside the [[Halls of Chokhin]])

==Dialogue==
:''"Ahai. I'm currently writing a paper on the origins of the [[Tyria (world)|world]]; more specifically [[Fahranur, The First City|the First City]] and how it relates to the ancient [[Orr]]ian Kings. I love ancient civilizations! Fascinating subject, isn't it?"''

==Trivia==
*This NPC is named after Gmr Leon, a frequent poster on the Guild Wars Online [[Fansite]] forum, known for his theories on Orr.
